White precipitate with Ag+ could be AgCl (white), AgBr (pale yellow), AgI (yellow), Ag2CO3 (brown), Ag2S (black), Ag2SO4 (white?), Ag2SO4 is slightly soluble, maybe white. But typical white precipitate suggests Cl- (AgCl) or possibly sulfate (Ag2SO4) but that is slightly soluble; also carbonate gives brown. So likely Cl-.

We should confirm with another test, e.g., add Ba(NO3)2 to see if precipitate forms (BaCl2 soluble, BaSO4 white, BaCO3 white). If Ba2+ with sample gives no precipitate, suggests not sulfate or carbonate. Let's test Ba(NO3)2.

Also could test with HCl acid to see if precipitate dissolves (AgCl dissolves in NH3). Could also test with NH3 to see dissolution.
